summary: The main bound and rectangle example are otherwise consistent, but the shifted-centroid estimate (3) is asserted under insufficient hypotheses.
critical_errors: Equation (3) is stated for an arbitrary set K of given area and centroid, although it is false without convexity and may even be undefined when r=0. Its proof explicitly uses convexity in the homothetic inclusion, and the cited Grünbaum inequality applies only to convex bodies. Thus (3), as written, is an invalid mathematical assertion.
repair_hints: State (3) for a two-dimensional convex body K. This supplies the convexity used in the proof and ensures that its centroid has positive centered inradius; then explicitly note that every application is to such an A_i.
